hypothesis: A single local Pfaffian computes c(S); fixed global aggregation is a separate obligation
dev_boundary: All partial matchings for n=2,3,4,5; compare n61 recurrence, explicit Mobius sum, local Pfaffian, and charged trace recurrence
test_boundary: Coordinator-only fixed fresh permutations and partial matchings at n=6,7,8; independent exact evaluator, committed source before boundary read
metric: fraction of four local coefficient identities checked; no local score proves a global polynomial extractor
gate_count: Count all add/mul of symbolic-entry trace Pfaffian recurrence; fixed rational divisions lower to rational-literal multiplication. Construction operations reported separately from scalar output gates.

frozen_extension.fixed_matrix: Two interleaved ports a_e,b_e per lexicographic edge e, then dummy g. K(a_e,b_e)=-1, K(a_g,b_g)=1; K(a_e,a_f)=1 for e<f; K(b_e,b_f)=-sgn(col_f-col_e); off-edge a/b couplings zero; dummy column larger than every real column. c(S)=Pf K[ports(S)+ports(g)]. Universe order 2n^2+2 is fixed before S.
four_assertions_per_matching: n61 recurrence coefficient equals independent Boolean Mobius sum
local Pfaffian equals Boolean Mobius sum
fixed paired principal Pfaffian equals Boolean Mobius sum
charged scalar trace compiler evaluates both Pfaffians exactly
frozen_extension.trace_compiler: Upper skew entries are formal input leaves; construct lower entries by negation gates, B=-J*A by a charged row negation/permutation, shared dense powers B^i, traces, and q_k=(1/(2k))*sum_i (-1)^(i-1) tr(B^i)q_(k-i). q0=1, output q_(d/2). No free extraction, Pfaffian, or derivative primitive.
frozen_extension.validation_strategy: Enumerate every matching. Cache values by its canonical column-order permutation only after deriving that both concrete matrices depend on that pattern; actual circuit shapes, binary operations and input assignments remain explicit. This cache is finite validation reuse, not a global contraction algorithm.
frozen_extension.aggregation_scope: Read-only mathematical examination of synchronized paired subsets; no negative experiment or arbitrary unpaired-subset oracle is run.
